title.zh: 卷367 列傳一百五十四 长龄 那彦成子：容安 容照 玉麟 特依顺保
title.en: Volume 367 Biographies 154: Zhang Ling, Na Yancheng son: Rong An, Rong Zhao, Yu Lin, Te Yi Shun Bao
title.raw: 卷367 列傳一百五十四 长龄 那彦成子：容安 容照 玉麟 特依顺保

sentences.zh: 列傳一百五十四

translations.literal: Biographies 154
translations.idiomatic: Biography 154

sentences.zh: 長齡，字懋亭，薩爾圖克氏，蒙古正白旗人，尚書納延泰子，惠齡之弟也。

translations.literal: Zhang Ling, style name Maoting, of the Sartu clan, a man of the Mongol Plain White Banner; son of Minister Nayantai and younger brother of Hui Ling.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling, whose style was Maoting, was of the Sartu clan, a Mongol of the Plain White Banner. He was the son of Minister Nayantai and younger brother of Hui Ling.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，由繙譯生員補工部筆帖式，充軍機章京，擢理籓院主事。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign he was made a clerk in the Ministry of Works from the ranks of translation students, served as a secretarial clerk in the Grand Council, and was promoted to director in the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign he entered service as a Ministry of Works clerk via the translation-student route, served as a Grand Council secretarial clerk, and rose to director in the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 從征甘肅、台灣、廓爾喀，累擢內閣學士，兼副都統。

translations.literal: He followed campaigns in Gansu, Taiwan, and Gurkha, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat academician, concurrently vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in campaigns in Gansu, Taiwan, and against the Gurkhas, and was repeatedly promoted until he became a Grand Secretariat academician while also serving as vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，授右翼總兵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he was appointed commander of the Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign (1799) he was appointed Right Wing commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，赴湖北剿教匪，為領隊大臣，數敗高天升、馬學禮於川、楚交界，授宜昌鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he went to Hubei to suppress the sect rebels, served as expeditionary grand secretary, repeatedly defeated Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli at the Sichuan-Hubei border, and was appointed commander of Yichang Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1800) he went to Hubei to suppress the White Lotus rebels, served as expeditionary commissioner, repeatedly defeated Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli along the Sichuan-Hubei border, and was made commander of the Yichang garrison.

sentences.zh: 又敗徐天德、苟文明等。

translations.literal: He again defeated Xu Tiande, Gou Wenming, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated Xu Tiande, Gou Wenming, and others.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢湖北提督，署總督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Hubei provincial military commander and acted as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1801) he was promoted to Hubei provincial military commander and served as acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七年，敗樊人傑、曾芝秀等，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he defeated Fan Renjie, Zeng Zhixiu, and others, and was granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1802) he defeated Fan Renjie, Zeng Zhixiu, and others and was granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 以病回京，歷左翼總兵，出為古北口提督。

translations.literal: Illness brought him back to the capital; he then served as Left Wing commander and went out as military commander at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the capital on account of illness, later served as Left Wing commander, and was then posted as military commander at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 九年，授安徽巡撫，擒蒙城教匪餘連。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Anhui governor and captured Yu Lian, remnant of the Mengcheng sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1804) he was appointed governor of Anhui and captured Yu Lian, a remnant rebel leader from Mengcheng.

sentences.zh: 十年，調山東。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1805) he was transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢陝甘總督，討平西寧叛番。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and pacified rebel Tibetans at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1807) he was promoted to governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu and suppressed the rebellious tribes at Xining.

sentences.zh: 十三年，坐在山東供應欽差侍郎廣興動用庫帑，褫職，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because while in Shandong he had supplied Imperial Commissioner Vice Minister Guang Xing with treasury funds, he was stripped of office and exiled to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1808) he was dismissed and banished to Ili for having, while governor of Shandong, supplied treasury funds to Imperial Commissioner Guang Xing.

sentences.zh: 尋予藍翎侍衛，充科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was given the post of Blue Feather Guard and served as assistant military governor at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon thereafter made a Blue Feather guardsman and appointed assistant military governor at Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1811) he was appointed governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，复授陝甘總督，剿擒南山匪首萬五等，晉騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was again appointed Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, suppressed and captured the southern mountain bandit leader Wan Wu and others, and was advanced to hereditary Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1813) he was reappointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu, captured the southern mountain bandit leader Wan Wu and others, and was advanced to hereditary Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，予都統銜，充伊犁參贊大臣，命察治回匪圖爾邁善獄，劾罷將軍松筠，遂代之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was given the brevet rank of commander-in-chief, served as assistant military governor at Ili, was ordered to investigate the case of the Muslim rebel Turmishan, impeached and removed General Songyun, and then replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1816) he received the brevet rank of commander-in-chief and served as Ili assistant military governor; ordered to investigate the Turmishan Muslim rebel case, he impeached and removed General Songyun and took his place.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，复授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was again appointed Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1817) he was again appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，加太子少保，協辦大學士，留總督任。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, appointed Grand Secretary in attendance, and retained his governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Daoguang reign (1821) he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Grand Secretary in attendance while remaining governor-general.

sentences.zh: 二年，署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the second year he acted as governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1822) he served as acting governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 會青海野番滋事，命回陝甘，遣總兵穆爾泰、馬騰龍討平之，賜雙眼花翎，拜文華殿大學士，管理籓院事，召還京。

translations.literal: When wild tribes in Qinghai caused trouble, he was ordered back to Shaanxi-Gansu and sent brigade commanders Muertai and Ma Tenglong to pacify them; he was granted the double-eyed peacock feather, appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory, put in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When wild tribes in Qinghai rose in revolt, he was ordered back to Shaanxi-Gansu and sent brigade commanders Muertai and Ma Tenglong to suppress them. He was awarded the double-eyed peacock feather, appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory with charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋以青海奏凱後，野番复渡河劫掠，奪雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: Soon after, because after the Qinghai victory report wild tribes again crossed the river to plunder, his double-eyed peacock feather was taken away.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because wild tribes again crossed the river to raid after his victory report from Qinghai, he was stripped of the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 三年，授軍機大臣，管理戶部三庫，充總諳達。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed Grand Council minister, placed in charge of the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue, and served as chief interpreter.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1823) he was appointed a Grand Council minister, placed in charge of the Ministry of Revenue's three treasuries, and served as chief interpreter.

sentences.zh: 四年，出為雲貴總督，五年，調陝甘，改授伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he went out as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; in the fifth year he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu and then reassigned as Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1824) he was posted as governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou; in the fifth year (1825) he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu and then appointed general of Ili.

sentences.zh: 初，回疆自乾隆中戡定後，歲徵貢稅頗約。

translations.literal: At first, after the Muslim frontier was pacified in the Qianlong reign, the annual tribute and taxes levied were quite moderate.
translations.idiomatic: At first, after the Muslim frontier was pacified in the Qianlong reign, annual tribute and tax levies were kept fairly light.

sentences.zh: 旋懲於烏什之亂，由辦事大臣縱肆激變，益慎選邊臣，回民賴以休息。

translations.literal: Then, chastened by the Ush rebellion, because frontier commissioners had been licentious and provoked uprisings, border officials were chosen with greater care, and the Muslim populace was able to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Then, chastened by the Ush rebellion, in which frontier commissioners had been abusive and provoked revolt, border officials were chosen with greater care and the Muslim populace was able to recover.

sentences.zh: 久之，法漸弛，蒞其任者，往往苛索伯克，伯克又斂之回民。

translations.literal: Over time the regulations gradually slackened; those who took office often harshly extorted the begs, and the begs in turn levied on the Muslim people.
translations.idiomatic: Over time regulations grew lax: incoming officials often extorted the begs harshly, and the begs in turn squeezed the Muslim populace.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶末，參贊大臣斌靜尤淫虐，失眾心。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiaqing, Assistant Military Governor Bin Jing was especially licentious and cruel and lost popular support.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jiaqing reign, Assistant Military Governor Bin Jing was especially cruel and debauched and lost the people's support.

sentences.zh: 張格爾者，回酋大和卓木博羅尼都之孫也。

translations.literal: Zhangge'er was the grandson of the Muslim chieftain Khoja Burhan al-Din of the Great Khoja clan.
translations.idiomatic: Jahangir Khoja was the grandson of Burhan al-Din, the Great Khoja Muslim chieftain.

sentences.zh: 博羅尼都當乾隆中以叛誅，至是張格爾因眾怨糾安集延、布魯特寇邊。

translations.literal: Burhan al-Din had been executed for rebellion in the Qianlong reign; now Zhangge'er, exploiting popular resentment, rallied Kokand and Kyrgyz to raid the border.
translations.idiomatic: Burhan al-Din had been executed for rebellion in the Qianlong reign; now Jahangir Khoja, exploiting popular resentment, rallied Kokand and Kyrgyz forces to raid the frontier.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，逮治斌靜，代以永芹，亦未能撫馭。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang, Bin Jing was arrested and punished; Yong Qin replaced him but also could not pacify and control the region.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang (1822), Bin Jing was arrested and punished; Yong Qin replaced him but likewise failed to pacify the region.

sentences.zh: 四年秋、五年夏兩次犯邊，領隊大臣巴彥圖敗績，遂益猖獗。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year and the summer of the fifth year they twice invaded the border; Expeditionary Commissioner Bayantu was defeated, and the rebels grew still more rampant.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year (1824) and the summer of the fifth (1825) they twice invaded the frontier; Expeditionary Commissioner Bayantu was defeated, and the rebels grew bolder still.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，張格爾大舉入卡，陷喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾、葉爾羌、和闐四城，命陝甘總督楊遇春駐哈密，督兵進剿。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year Zhangge'er launched a major invasion through the passes, seized the four cities of Kashgar, Yengisar, Yarkand, and Khotan, and Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yang Yuchun was ordered to station at Hami and direct the advance to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year (1826), Jahangir Khoja launched a major invasion through the passes and captured Kashgar, Yengisar, Yarkand, and Khotan. Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yang Yuchun was ordered to station at Hami and direct the punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 長齡疏言：「逆酋已踞巢穴，全局蠢動。

translations.literal: Zhang Ling memorialized: "The rebel chieftain has already occupied his lair, and the whole situation is stirring.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling memorialized: "The rebel chieftain has already seized his stronghold, and the entire region is in turmoil.

sentences.zh: 喀城距阿克蘇二千里，四面回村，中多戈壁，非伊犁、烏魯木齊六千援兵所能克。

translations.literal: Kashgar is two thousand li from Aksu, surrounded on all sides by Muslim villages, with much desert in between—not something the six thousand relief troops from Ili and Urumqi can overcome.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar lies two thousand li from Aksu, ringed by Muslim villages with much desert between—not a target the six thousand relief troops from Ili and Urumqi can take.

sentences.zh: 請速發大兵四萬，以萬五千分護糧台，以二萬五千進戰。

translations.literal: I request that a main force of forty thousand be dispatched quickly—fifteen thousand to guard the supply depots and twenty-five thousand to advance and fight.
translations.idiomatic: I urge that a main force of forty thousand be sent at once: fifteen thousand to guard the supply depots and twenty-five thousand to advance and fight.

sentences.zh: 」詔授長齡揚威將軍，遇春及山東巡撫武隆阿為參贊，率諸軍討之。

translations.literal: " An edict appointed Zhang Ling Pacification General, with Yuchun and Shandong Governor Wulong'a as deputies, to lead the armies in suppressing the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict appointed Chang Ling Pacification General, with Yang Yuchun and Shandong Governor Wulong'a as deputies, to lead the armies against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 十月，師抵阿克蘇。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the army reached Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the army reached Aksu.

sentences.zh: 時提督達凌阿等已敗賊渾巴什河，張格爾以眾三千踞柯爾坪，令提督楊芳襲破之。

translations.literal: At that time Provincial Commander Dalin'a and others had already defeated the rebels at the Hunbash River; Zhangge'er held Korla with three thousand men, and Provincial Commander Yang Fang was ordered to attack and break them.
translations.idiomatic: By then Provincial Commander Dalin'a and others had already defeated the rebels at the Hunbash River. Jahangir Khoja held Korla with three thousand men, and Provincial Commander Yang Fang was ordered to attack and rout them.

sentences.zh: 大雪封山，兵止未進，疏言：「前奉旨兵分二路，正兵由中路台站、奇兵由烏什草地，繞出喀城，斷其竄遁。

translations.literal: Heavy snow blocked the mountains and the troops halted without advancing; he memorialized: "Previously I received orders to divide the army into two routes—the main force along the central relay stations and a flanking force through the Ush grasslands to circle out to Kashgar and cut off their escape.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow blocked the passes and the army halted. He memorialized: "I had previously been ordered to divide the army into two routes—the main force along the central relay stations and a flanking force through the Ush grasslands to circle behind Kashgar and cut off the rebels' escape.

sentences.zh: 惟烏什卡倫外直抵巴爾昌，山溝險狹，戈壁數百里，所經布魯特部落，半為賊煽，未可孤軍深入。

translations.literal: But beyond the Ush pass stations the route runs straight to Balchuan through narrow, perilous ravines and hundreds of li of desert; the Kyrgyz tribes along the way are half incited by the rebels—not suitable for a lone column to penetrate deeply.
translations.idiomatic: But beyond the Ush passes the route runs straight to Balchuan through narrow ravines and hundreds of li of desert; Kyrgyz tribes along the way are half incited by the rebels—a lone column cannot safely penetrate so far.

sentences.zh: 且留防阿克蘇、烏什、庫車兵八千餘，其延、綏、四川兵尚未到。

translations.literal: Moreover, more than eight thousand troops remain to garrison Aksu, Ush, and Kucha, while the troops from Yan'an, Suiyuan, and Sichuan have not yet arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, more than eight thousand troops are tied down garrisoning Aksu, Ush, and Kucha, while reinforcements from Yan'an, Suiyuan, and Sichuan have not yet arrived.

sentences.zh: 進剿之步騎止二萬二千，兩路相距二十餘站，聲息不通。

translations.literal: The infantry and cavalry available for the advance are only twenty-two thousand; the two routes are more than twenty relay stations apart and cannot communicate.
translations.idiomatic: Only twenty-two thousand infantry and cavalry are available for the advance; the two routes lie more than twenty relay stations apart and cannot coordinate.

sentences.zh: 喀城賊眾不下數十萬，非全軍直搗，反正為奇，難期無失。

translations.literal: The rebel forces at Kashgar number no fewer than several hundred thousand; unless the whole army strikes straight at them, turning flanking maneuvers into the main effort will make failure hard to avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel forces at Kashgar number at least several hundred thousand; unless the whole army strikes directly at them, relying on flanking maneuvers risks failure.

sentences.zh: 喀城邊外凡十卡，皆接外夷，恐賊敗遁，已諭黑回約眾邀截。

translations.literal: Beyond Kashgar there are ten passes in all, all bordering foreign lands; fearing the rebels might flee in defeat, he had already instructed the Black Muslims to gather crowds and intercept them.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Kashgar lie ten passes bordering foreign territory; fearing the rebels might flee in defeat, he had already instructed loyal Black Muslims to gather forces and intercept them.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，師至巴爾楚軍台，為喀、葉二城分道處，复留兵三千以防繞襲。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year the army reached the Balchuan military station, the point where routes divide toward Kashgar and Yarkand, and again left three thousand troops to guard against encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year (1827) the army reached the Balchuan military station, where routes divide toward Kashgar and Yarkand, and again left three thousand troops to guard against encirclement.

sentences.zh: 進次大河拐，賊屯洋阿爾巴特，​​夜來犯營，卻之。

translations.literal: Advancing to Daheguai, the rebels were encamped at Yang'arbat; they attacked the camp by night and were repulsed.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Daheguai, they found the rebels encamped at Yang'arbat; the rebels attacked by night and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 遂由中路進，殲賊萬餘，擒五千。

translations.literal: Then they advanced by the central route, annihilating more than ten thousand rebels and capturing five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: They then advanced along the central route, killing more than ten thousand rebels and capturing five thousand.

sentences.zh: 越三日，張格爾拒戰於沙布都爾，多樹葦，決水成沮洳，賊數万臨渠橫列。

translations.literal: Three days later Zhangge'er made a stand at Shabudur, planting many reeds and breaching dikes to create marsh; tens of thousands of rebels lined the canal in battle array.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later Jahangir Khoja made a stand at Shabudur, planting reeds and breaching dikes to flood the ground; tens of thousands of rebels lined the canal in battle formation.

sentences.zh: 乃令步卒越渠鏖鬥，騎兵繞左右橫截入陣，賊潰，追逾渾水河，擒斬萬計。

translations.literal: He then ordered infantry to cross the canal and fight fiercely, while cavalry circled left and right to cut into the formation; the rebels broke, were pursued beyond the Hunshui River, and tens of thousands were captured or killed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered infantry to cross the canal and fight at close quarters while cavalry circled to cut into the flanks; the rebels broke and were pursued beyond the Hunshui River, with tens of thousands captured or killed.

sentences.zh: 又越二日，進剿阿瓦巴特，分三路掩殺，俘斬二萬有奇。

translations.literal: Two days later they advanced against Awabat, divided into three routes for a converging attack, and captured or killed more than twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later they advanced on Awabat in a three-pronged assault and captured or killed more than twenty thousand.

sentences.zh: 追至洋達瑪河，距喀城僅十餘裡，賊悉眾十餘萬背城阻河而陣，亙二十餘裡，選死士夜擾其營。

translations.literal: Pursuit reached the Yandama River, only a dozen or so li from Kashgar; the rebels mustered their full strength of more than a hundred thousand, backed against the city and blocking the river in formation for more than twenty li, and selected dare-to-die troops to harass the camp by night.
translations.idiomatic: The pursuit reached the Yandama River, only a dozen li from Kashgar; the rebels massed more than a hundred thousand men with their backs to the city, blocking the river in a line over twenty li long, and sent suicide squads to harass the camp by night.

sentences.zh: 會大風霾，用楊遇春策，遣索倫千騎繞趨下游牽賊勢，大兵驟渡上游蹙之，賊陣亂，乃大奔，乘勝抵喀什噶爾，克之。

translations.literal: A great wind and dust storm arose; adopting Yang Yuchun's plan, he sent a thousand Solon cavalry downstream to draw the rebel force, while the main army suddenly crossed upstream to press them; the rebel formation broke into a great rout, and pressing the advantage they reached Kashgar and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: A great dust storm arose; adopting Yang Yuchun's plan, he sent a thousand Solon cavalry downstream to draw the rebel force while the main army suddenly crossed upstream to press them. The rebel line collapsed in flight, and pressing the advantage they reached and captured Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 時三月朔日也。

translations.literal: This was on the first day of the third month.
translations.idiomatic: This was on the first day of the third month.

sentences.zh: 張格爾已先遁，獲其侄與甥，及安集延酋推立汗、薩木汗。

translations.literal: Zhangge'er had already fled beforehand; his nephew and nephew-by-marriage were captured, along with the Kokand chiefs Tuoli Khan and Samu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Jahangir Khoja had already fled; his nephew and nephew-by-marriage were captured, along with the Kokand chiefs Tuoli Khan and Samu Khan.

sentences.zh: 分兵令遇春下英吉沙爾、葉爾羌，芳下和闐，於是四城皆复。

translations.literal: Troops were divided, ordering Yuchun down to Yengisar and Yarkand and Fang down to Khotan; thus all four cities were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Forces were divided: Yang Yuchun was sent to recover Yengisar and Yarkand, Yang Fang to Khotan—and all four cities were restored.

sentences.zh: 上以元惡漏網，嚴詔詰責，限速捕獲。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the chief villain had slipped the net, issued a stern edict of reprimand with a time limit for his capture.
translations.idiomatic: Because the chief villain had escaped, the emperor issued a stern reprimand with a deadline for his capture.

sentences.zh: 六月，遇春、芳率兵八千出塞窮追，遇春屯色勒庫，芳屯阿賴，諭各部落擒獻。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yuchun and Fang led eight thousand troops beyond the passes in relentless pursuit; Yuchun encamped at Serku and Fang at Alai, instructing the various tribes to capture and deliver the fugitive.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yang Yuchun and Yang Fang led eight thousand troops beyond the frontier in pursuit; Yuchun encamped at Serku and Fang at Alai, instructing the tribes to capture and hand over the fugitive.

sentences.zh: 浩罕遣諜誘官軍入伏，鏖戰幾殆，僅得出險。

translations.literal: Kokand sent spies to lure the government army into an ambush; after fierce fighting they were nearly destroyed and only barely escaped danger.
translations.idiomatic: Kokand sent agents to lure the government forces into an ambush; after fierce fighting they were nearly wiped out and barely escaped.

sentences.zh: 詔斥諸將老師糜餉，留兵八千，餘命遇春率兵入關，芳代為參贊。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked the generals for keeping the army long in the field and wasting supplies; eight thousand troops were left behind, and the rest were ordered to enter the passes under Yuchun, with Fang replacing him as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked the generals for prolonging the campaign and wasting supplies; eight thousand troops were left behind while Yang Yuchun was ordered to lead the rest back inside the frontier, with Yang Fang replacing him as deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 當大軍之出，密詔詢將軍、參贊：事平後，西四城可否仿土司分封。

translations.literal: When the main army set out, a secret edict asked the general and deputies whether after pacification the four western cities could be enfeoffed on the model of native chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army set out, a secret edict asked the general and deputies whether, once pacified, the four western cities could be enfeoffed like native chieftaincies.

sentences.zh: 至是，長齡疏言：「愚回崇信和卓，猶西番崇信達賴，即使張逆就擒，尚有兄弟之子在浩罕，終留後患。

translations.literal: At this point Zhang Ling memorialized: "The foolish Muslims revere the Khojas as Tibetans revere the Dalai Lama; even if the Zhang rebel were captured, his brother's sons remain in Kokand and would ultimately leave a lingering threat.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Chang Ling memorialized: "Muslims revere the Khojas as Tibetans revere the Dalai Lama; even if the Jahangir rebel were captured, his brother's sons remain in Kokand and would leave a lasting threat.

sentences.zh: 八千留防之兵難制百萬犬羊之眾。

translations.literal: The eight thousand troops left to garrison can hardly control a million wolf-and-sheep people.
translations.idiomatic: Eight thousand garrison troops cannot control a million unruly subjects.

sentences.zh: 博羅尼都之子阿布都哈里尚羈在京師，惟有赦歸，令總轄西四城，可以服內夷、制外患。

translations.literal: Burhan al-Din's son Abduhari is still detained in the capital; only by pardoning and returning him to oversee the four western cities can internal tribes be subdued and external threats controlled.
translations.idiomatic: Burhan al-Din's son Abduhari is still held in the capital; only by pardoning him and sending him back to govern the four western cities can internal tribes be won over and external threats checked.

sentences.zh: 」武隆阿亦以為言。

translations.literal: " Wulong'a also spoke to the same effect.
translations.idiomatic: " Wulong'a argued likewise.

sentences.zh: 上切責其請釋逆裔之謬，並革職留任，命那彥成為欽差大臣，代長齡籌善後。

translations.literal: The emperor sharply rebuked the error of their request to release the rebel scion, stripped them of office but kept them on duty, and appointed Na Yancheng Imperial Commissioner to replace Zhang Ling in planning postwar arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sharply rebuked their error in seeking to release a rebel heir, stripped them of rank but kept them in post, and appointed Na Yancheng Imperial Commissioner to replace Chang Ling in planning the aftermath.

sentences.zh: 張格爾傳食諸部落，日窮蹙。

translations.literal: Zhangge'er lived off the various tribes and grew daily more desperate.
translations.idiomatic: Jahangir Khoja lived off the tribes and grew daily more desperate.

sentences.zh: 長齡等遣黑回誘之，率步騎五百，欲乘歲除襲喀城。

translations.literal: Zhang Ling and others sent loyal Black Muslims to lure him; he led five hundred infantry and cavalry, intending to strike Kashgar on New Year's Eve.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling and others sent loyal Black Muslims to lure him; he led five hundred foot and horse, planning to strike Kashgar on New Year's Eve.

sentences.zh: 芳嚴兵以待，賊覺而奔，追至喀爾鐵蓋山，擊斬殆盡。

translations.literal: Fang held the army ready; the rebels sensed it and fled; pursuit reached Mount Ka'ertiegai and nearly all were struck down or killed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fang held the army ready; the rebels sensed the trap and fled; pursuit to Mount Ka'ertiegai left nearly all dead.

sentences.zh: 張格爾僅餘三十人，棄騎登山，副將胡超、都司段永福等擒之。

translations.literal: Zhangge'er had only thirty men left; abandoning his horse he climbed the mountain, and Brigade Deputy Hu Chao, Company Commander Duan Yongfu, and others captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Jahangir Khoja had only thirty men left; he abandoned his horse and climbed the mountain, where Brigade Deputy Hu Chao, Company Commander Duan Yongfu, and others seized him.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，捷聞，上大悅，錫封長齡二等威勇公，世襲罔替，賜寶石頂、四團龍補服、紫韁，授御前大臣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year news of victory arrived; the emperor was greatly pleased and enfeoffed Zhang Ling as Duke Weiyong of the second rank, hereditary in perpetuity, granted the jeweled finial, four-clawed dragon surcoat, and purple bridle, and appointed him Grand Minister in Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year (1828) news of victory arrived; the emperor was greatly pleased and enfeoffed Chang Ling as Duke Weiyong of the second rank with perpetual hereditary succession, granted the jeweled finial, four-clawed dragon surcoat, and purple bridle, and appointed him Grand Minister in Attendance.

sentences.zh: 諸將封賞有差。

translations.literal: The various generals received enfeoffments and rewards in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The various generals received rewards in differing degrees.

sentences.zh: 五月，檻送張格爾於京師，上御午門受俘，磔於市。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Zhangge'er was sent in a cage to the capital; the emperor received the captive at the Meridian Gate and had him dismembered in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Jahangir Khoja was sent to the capital in a cage; the emperor received the captive at the Meridian Gate and had him dismembered in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 晉長齡太保，賜三眼花翎，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: Zhang Ling was advanced to Grand Guardian, granted the triple-eyed peacock feather, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling was advanced to Grand Guardian, granted the triple-eyed peacock feather, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 尋回京，命親王大臣迎勞，行抱見禮於勤政殿。

translations.literal: Soon after he returned to the capital; princes and grand ministers were ordered to welcome and congratulate him, and the embrace audience ceremony was performed at the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: He soon returned to the capital; princes and grand ministers were ordered to welcome him, and the embrace-audience ceremony was performed at the Hall of Diligent Government.

sentences.zh: 授閱兵大臣，管理籓院及戶部三庫，正大光明殿賜凱宴，賜銀幣，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed Minister of Troop Review, placed in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs and the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue, given a victory banquet at the Hall of Great Brightness, granted silver coins, and appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Minister of Troop Review, placed in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs and the Ministry of Revenue's three treasuries, given a victory banquet at the Hall of Great Brightness, granted silver coins, and appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 恩禮優渥，並用乾隆朝故事，時稱盛焉。

translations.literal: Favors and ceremonies were exceptionally generous, all following precedents of the Qianlong reign; contemporaries called it a grand occasion.
translations.idiomatic: Favors and ceremonies were exceptionally generous, all following Qianlong-era precedents; contemporaries called it a grand occasion.

sentences.zh: 十年秋，浩罕以內地安集延被驅逐，貲產皆鈔沒，積怨憤，遂挾張格爾之兄玉素普及其黨博巴克等復入邊，圍喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾二城，且犯葉爾羌。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the tenth year Kokand, because Kokandis in the interior had been expelled and their property all confiscated, nursed accumulated resentment and, taking Zhangge'er's brother Yusupu and his partisans Bobake and others, again entered the border, besieging Kashgar and Yengisar and also attacking Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the tenth year (1830), Kokand, resenting the expulsion of its subjects from the interior and the confiscation of their property, rallied Jahangir Khoja's brother Yusupu and partisans such as Bobake to raid the frontier again, besieging Kashgar and Yengisar and attacking Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 復命長齡為揚威將軍，往督師。

translations.literal: Zhang Ling was again appointed Pacification General and sent to supervise the army.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling was again appointed Pacification General and sent to supervise the campaign.

sentences.zh: 會葉爾羌辦事大臣璧昌連破賊，長齡令參讚哈哴阿、提督胡超分路進援喀、英二城，賊聞風解圍遁出塞。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Yarkand Commissioner Bichang repeatedly defeated the rebels; Zhang Ling ordered Deputy Hal'a and Provincial Commander Hu Chao to advance by separate routes to relieve Kashgar and Yengisar, and the rebels, hearing the news, lifted the siege and fled beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Yarkand Commissioner Bichang had repeatedly defeated the rebels; Chang Ling ordered Deputy Hal'a and Provincial Commander Hu Chao to advance by separate routes to relieve Kashgar and Yengisar, and the rebels, hearing of the relief force, lifted the siege and fled beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 於是偕伊犁將軍玉麟合疏陳善後事，略曰：「此次入寇，與張格爾不同，不過烏合夷眾，挾驅逐鈔沒之憾，虜掠取償，無志於土地人民。

translations.literal: Thereupon he joined Ili General Yulin in a joint memorial on postwar arrangements, stating in summary: "This invasion differs from Zhangge'er's; it is only a mob of barbarians, bearing the grievance of expulsion and confiscation, raiding for compensation, with no ambition for territory or population.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Ili General Yulin in a joint memorial on postwar arrangements, stating in summary: "This invasion differs from Jahangir Khoja's campaign; it is only a mob of tribesmen, nursing grievances over expulsion and confiscation, raiding for compensation, with no ambition to hold territory or people.

sentences.zh: 各白回畏賊騷掠，助順守禦，亦非上年甘心從逆之比。

translations.literal: The various White Muslims fear the rebels' harassment and help the loyal side in defense—not comparable to last year when they willingly followed the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: White Muslims fear rebel raids and help loyal forces defend the cities—not comparable to last year when many willingly followed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 此時戰緩而守急。

translations.literal: At this time offense may be slow but defense is urgent.
translations.idiomatic: At this moment offense can wait but defense cannot.

sentences.zh: 惟兵未至而賊已先逃，兵久駐而賊無一獲，戰守俱無長策。

translations.literal: Yet when troops have not arrived the rebels have already fled; when troops stay long in the field not one rebel is taken—neither offense nor defense has a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when troops arrive the rebels have already fled; when troops linger in the field not one rebel is captured—neither offense nor defense offers a sound strategy.

sentences.zh: 諸臣條奏增兵廣屯，以省徵調，言之似易，行之實難，即收效亦在數十年之後。

translations.literal: Various officials have memorialized in detail to increase troops and expand colonies to save on levies; it sounds easy but is hard in practice, and even if effective the results would come only decades later.
translations.idiomatic: Officials have proposed increasing troops and expanding frontier colonies to reduce levies; this sounds easy but is hard to implement, and even if it worked, results would come only decades later.

sentences.zh: 若仿土司以西四城付阿奇木伯克，回性懦弱，非浩罕敵；

translations.literal: If on the native-chieftain model the four western cities were entrusted to the aqim begs, Muslims are by nature weak and no match for Kokand;
translations.idiomatic: If the four western cities were entrusted to aqim begs on the native-chieftain model, Muslims are by nature weak and no match for Kokand;

sentences.zh: 苟無官兵守禦，賊至必如入無人之境。

translations.literal: if there were no government troops to defend them, when rebels came it would be like entering unoccupied territory.
translations.idiomatic: without government troops to defend them, rebels would march in as if through empty land.

sentences.zh: 臣等再四籌商，統兵之人宜立不敗之地，斯能製人而不為人制，惟有移參贊大臣於葉爾羌，其地本回疆都會，距喀什噶爾六站，在不遠不近之間。

translations.literal: We have deliberated again and again: the commander should establish himself in an invincible position so he can control others and not be controlled—only by moving the assistant military governor to Yarkand, which is the Muslim frontier metropolis, six relay stations from Kashgar, neither too far nor too near.
translations.idiomatic: We have deliberated repeatedly: the commander must establish an impregnable base so he can control others rather than be controlled—only by moving the assistant military governor to Yarkand, the Muslim frontier capital, six relay stations from Kashgar, at a manageable distance.

sentences.zh: 再移和闐領隊大臣備調遣。

translations.literal: Move the Khotan expeditionary commissioner as well to stand ready for deployment.
translations.idiomatic: Move the Khotan expeditionary commissioner as well to stand ready for deployment.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾留換防總兵一，與英吉沙爾領隊為犄角。

translations.literal: Leave one rotating garrison commander at Kashgar to form a pincer with the Yengisar expeditionary force.
translations.idiomatic: Leave one rotating garrison commander at Kashgar to form a pincer with the Yengisar expeditionary force.

sentences.zh: 巴爾楚克駐守總兵一，為樹窩子咽喉鎖鑰。

translations.literal: Station one commander at Balchuan as the throat-and-lock of Shuwazi.
translations.idiomatic: Station one commander at Balchuan as the strategic choke point at Shuwazi.

sentences.zh: 六城相距均不過數百里。

translations.literal: The six cities are all within several hundred li of one another.
translations.idiomatic: The six cities lie within several hundred li of one another.

sentences.zh: 於西四城額兵六千之外，留伊犁騎兵三千，陝甘綠營兵四千，量分駐守，而以重兵隨參贊居中調度。

translations.literal: Beyond the six thousand allotted troops for the four western cities, retain three thousand Ili cavalry and four thousand Shaanxi-Gansu Green Standard troops, apportioned as garrisons, with heavy forces following the assistant military governor at the center for coordination.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the six thousand allotted troops for the four western cities, retain three thousand Ili cavalry and four thousand Shaanxi-Gansu Green Standard troops in distributed garrisons, with a strong central force under the assistant military governor for coordination.

sentences.zh: 新兵糧餉，請於各省綠營兵額內裁百分之二，歲省三十餘萬，以為回疆兵餉。

translations.literal: For the new troops' pay and provisions, we request cutting two percent from each province's Green Standard quotas, saving more than three hundred thousand taels per year for Muslim frontier military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: For the new troops' pay and provisions, we request cutting two percent from each province's Green Standard quotas, saving more than three hundred thousand taels annually for Muslim frontier military expenses.

sentences.zh: 俟屯田有效，即以回疆兵食守回疆，仍撤回內地餉額。

translations.literal: When frontier colonies become effective, use Muslim frontier grain to support Muslim frontier troops and restore the interior pay quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Once frontier colonies become productive, Muslim frontier grain should support Muslim frontier troops and interior pay quotas can be restored.

sentences.zh: 」又疏請招民開墾西四城閒地以供兵糈。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized to recruit settlers to open idle land in the four western cities to supply military grain.
translations.idiomatic: " He also memorialized to recruit settlers to open idle land in the four western cities to supply military grain.

sentences.zh: 又請添設同知二、巡檢五，由陝、甘選勤能之員任之。

translations.literal: He also requested adding two subprefects and five inspectors, to be filled by diligent, capable men selected from Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested adding two subprefects and five inspectors, to be filled by capable officials selected from Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 並下廷議，往復再三，罷設文員，減滿、漢兵二千五百名，新增餉需不過十萬兩，各城額徵糧科可敷供支，乃允行。

translations.literal: The proposals were referred to court deliberation; after repeated back-and-forth, the civil posts were dropped, Manchu and Han troops were reduced by twenty-five hundred, new pay needs would not exceed one hundred thousand taels, and the allotted grain taxes of each city could cover expenses—then approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposals went to court deliberation; after repeated debate, civil posts were dropped, Manchu and Han troops were cut by twenty-five hundred, new expenses would not exceed one hundred thousand taels, and allotted grain taxes from each city could cover costs—then the plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 以璧昌為參贊大臣，各城聽節制。

translations.literal: Bi Chang was appointed assistant military governor; all cities were to obey his command.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Chang was appointed assistant military governor, with all cities placed under his authority.

sentences.zh: 其辦事、領隊各大臣，命長齡等保奏任用。

translations.literal: As for the various resident and brigade commissioners, the court ordered Chang Ling and others to recommend candidates for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Chang Ling and others to recommend and nominate the various resident and brigade commissioners.

sentences.zh: 浩罕懼大軍出討，乞援俄羅斯，俄人拒之，乃遣頭人詣軍求通商。

translations.literal: Kokand, fearing that a great army would march to punish it, begged aid from Russia; the Russians refused, and it then sent tribal leaders to the army to request trade.
translations.idiomatic: Kokand, fearing a punitive expedition, appealed to Russia for aid; when the Russians refused, Kokand sent tribal leaders to the army to seek permission to resume trade.

sentences.zh: 長齡責縛獻賊目，釋還兵民，來報原還俘虜，复乞免稅，並給還所沒貲財。

translations.literal: Chang Ling charged them to bind and present rebel leaders and release soldiers and civilians; they came reporting captives restored, again begged tax exemption, and also sought return of confiscated property.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling demanded bound rebel chieftains and the release of soldiers and civilians; their envoys reported captives restored, sought tax exemptions, and asked for the return of confiscated goods.

sentences.zh: 上方欲示以寬大，且謂獻犯亦不足信，一切允之。

translations.literal: The throne wished to display magnanimity, and moreover held that surrendered culprits were not to be trusted—everything was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to show clemency and held that surrendered criminals could not be trusted anyway; all requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 浩罕喜過望，進表納貢通商如故，邊境乃安。

translations.literal: Kokand rejoiced beyond expectation, submitted a memorial and tribute, and trade as before; the borderlands then became secure.
translations.idiomatic: Kokand rejoiced beyond all expectation, submitted memorials and tribute, and resumed trade as before; the frontier was pacified.

sentences.zh: 長齡駐回疆凡兩載，十二年，回京，晉太傅，管理兵部，調戶部，賜四開褉袍。

translations.literal: Chang Ling had garrisoned the Muslim frontier for two years in all; in the twelfth year he returned to the capital, was advanced to Grand Preceptor, managed the Board of War, was transferred to the Board of Revenue, and was granted a four-clawed dragon robe.
translations.idiomatic: After two years on the Muslim frontier, in the twelfth year Chang Ling returned to Beijing, was promoted to Grand Preceptor, put in charge of the Board of War, transferred to the Board of Revenue, and granted a four-clawed dragon robe.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以病乞休，上親視其疾，溫詔慰留。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, on grounds of illness he begged to retire; the emperor personally visited him in his illness, and with a warm edict urged him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he pleaded illness to retire; the emperor personally visited him, and with a warm edict urged him to stay on.

sentences.zh: 以八十壽，晉一等公爵。

translations.literal: On reaching his eightieth birthday, he was advanced to first-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: On his eightieth birthday he was promoted to first-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 次年，卒，上震悼，親奠，賜金治喪，入祀賢良祠、伊犁名宦祠，諡文襄。

translations.literal: The next year he died; the emperor was deeply shaken and grieved, offered sacrifices in person, granted gold for the funeral, entered the Worthies Shrine and the Ili shrine of distinguished officials, posthumous title Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he died; the emperor was deeply grieved, offered sacrifices in person, granted gold for the funeral, and had him enshrined in the Worthies Shrine and the Ili shrine of distinguished officials, with the posthumous title Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 十九年，命每次謁陵後，賜奠其墓。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, it was ordered that after each imperial tomb visit, sacrifices be granted at his tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the court ordered that after each imperial tomb visit, sacrifices be offered at his tomb.

sentences.zh: 子桂輪，襲公爵，官至烏里雅蘇台、杭州將軍，諡恪慎。

translations.literal: His son Guilun inherited the dukedom, rose to General at Uliasutai and Hangzhou, posthumous title Kezhen.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guilun inherited the dukedom, served as general at Uliasutai and Hangzhou, and received the posthumous title Kezhen.

sentences.zh: 孫麟興，襲爵，亦官烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: His grandson Linxing inherited the rank and also served as General of Uliasutai.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Linxing inherited the title and also served as general of Uliasutai.

sentences.zh: 那彥成，字繹堂，章佳氏，滿洲正白旗人，大學士阿桂孫。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng, whose style was Yetang, was of the Zhangjia clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner, and grandson of Grand Secretary Agui.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng, style Yetang, was of the Zhangjia clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner, and grandson of Grand Secretary Agui.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，直南書房。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year of Qianlong he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and served in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year of the Qianlong reign he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and served in the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 四遷為內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted four times to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted four times to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing he was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaqing he was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 遷工部侍郎，調戶部，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Works, then to the Board of Revenue, and concurrently served as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice minister of works, transferred to the Board of Revenue, and concurrently served as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 擢工部尚書，兼都統、內務府大臣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Works and concurrently served as commandant-in-chief and Grand Minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of works and concurrently served as commandant-in-chief and grand minister of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 那彥成三歲​​而孤，母那拉氏，守志，撫之成立，至是三十載，仁宗御書「勵節教忠」額表其門。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng was orphaned at three; his mother, of the Nara clan, kept her widowhood, reared him to maturity—now thirty years—and the Jiaqing Emperor personally wrote the plaque "Encouraging Integrity and Teaching Loyalty" to honor her gate.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng was orphaned at three; his mother, of the Nara clan, remained a widow and raised him to maturity. After thirty years the Jiaqing Emperor personally inscribed the plaque "Encouraging Integrity and Teaching Loyalty" for her household.

sentences.zh: 時教匪張漢潮久擾陝西，參贊大臣明亮及將軍慶成、巡撫永保同剿之，互有隙，師行不相顧。

translations.literal: At the time the sect rebel Zhang Han-chao had long troubled Shaanxi; Assistant Military Governor Mingliang, General Qingcheng, and Governor Yongbao jointly suppressed him, but bore mutual grudges and on campaign did not support one another.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the sect rebel Zhang Han-chao had long ravaged Shaanxi; Assistant Military Governor Mingliang, General Qingcheng, and Governor Yongbao were jointly suppressing him, but feuded among themselves and failed to coordinate on campaign.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，命那彥成為欽差大臣，督明亮軍，褫慶成、永保職，逮治。

translations.literal: That autumn Na Yancheng was appointed Imperial Commissioner to supervise Mingliang's army; Qingcheng and Yongbao were stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Na Yancheng was appointed Imperial Commissioner to supervise Mingliang's forces; Qingcheng and Yongbao were stripped of rank and arrested.

sentences.zh: 那彥成以樞臣出膺軍寄，意銳甚。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng, as a Grand Councilor taking up military command, was very keen in spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng, a Grand Councilor now entrusted with military command, was full of fighting spirit.

sentences.zh: 明亮聞其將至，急擊賊敗之，漢潮伏誅。

translations.literal: Mingliang, hearing he was about to arrive, urgently attacked and defeated the rebels; Han-chao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang, hearing of his approach, pressed the attack, defeated the rebels, and Han-chao was executed.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其先聲奪人，特詔褒美。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his seizing the initiative and issued a special edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his seizing the initiative and issued a special edict commending him.

sentences.zh: 漢潮黨冉學勝亦狡悍，猶在陝。

translations.literal: Han-chao's partisan Ran Xuesheng was also cunning and fierce and still remained in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Han-chao's lieutenant Ran Xuesheng was likewise cunning and fierce and still held out in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬，敗之五郎。

translations.literal: In winter he was defeated at Wulang.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he was defeated at Wulang.

sentences.zh: 竄秦嶺老林，又迭敗之高關峪、夾嶺、鳳皇山。

translations.literal: He fled into the old forests of the Qin Mountains and was repeatedly defeated at Gaoguanyu, Jialing, and Fenghuang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He fled into the old-growth forests of the Qin Mountains and was repeatedly defeated at Gaoguanyu, Jialing, and Fenghuang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 賊乘間逸入湖北、河南境。

translations.literal: The rebels seized an opening and slipped into Hubei and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels seized an opening and slipped into Hubei and Henan.

sentences.zh: 五年春，進兵漢中，遂入棧剿川匪，追出棧，大破之隴州隴山鎮，俘斬甚眾，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year he advanced on Hanzhong, then entered the plank roads to suppress Sichuan bandits; pursuing them beyond the passes he routed them at Longzhou's Longshan Town, capturing and killing many, and was appointed assistant military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year he advanced on Hanzhong, entered the plank roads to suppress Sichuan bandits, pursued them beyond the passes, and routed them at Longshan Town in Longzhou, capturing and killing many; he was then appointed assistant military governor.

sentences.zh: 會經略額勒登保病，上以那彥成隴山捷後，軍威已振，命兼督各路兵。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Pacification Commissioner Eledengbao fell ill; the emperor, since after Na Yancheng's Longshan victory military prestige was already revived, ordered him concurrently to supervise all routes.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Pacification Commissioner Eledengbao fell ill; the emperor, seeing that Na Yancheng's victory at Longshan had revived army morale, ordered him to supervise all routes concurrently.

sentences.zh: 高天升、馬學禮陷文縣，踞卡郎寨。

translations.literal: Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli seized Wen County and held Kalang Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli seized Wen County and held Kalang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 乘夜渡河破之，賊南竄，趨松潘、岷州。

translations.literal: He crossed the river by night and broke them; the rebels fled south toward Songpan and Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the river by night and routed them; the rebels fled south toward Songpan and Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保病起，合擊敗之，餘賊將竄川境，即陰平入蜀道也。

translations.literal: Eledengbao recovered from illness; joining forces they defeated them; the remnant rebels were about to flee into Sichuan—the Yinping route into Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao recovered and joined forces to defeat them; the remnant rebels were about to flee into Sichuan by the Yinping route into Shu.

sentences.zh: 那彥成以地險不利騎兵，檄總兵百祥迎擊於農安，自率師回陝。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng, because the terrain was rugged and unfavorable to cavalry, ordered Brigadier Baixiang to intercept at Nong'an while he himself led the army back to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng, finding the terrain too rugged for cavalry, ordered Brigadier Baixiang to intercept at Nong'an and led his own forces back to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 初，那彥成西行，以南山餘賊付巡撫台佈。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Na Yancheng marched west, he entrusted the southern mountain remnant rebels to Governor Taibu.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Na Yancheng marched west, he left the remnant rebels in the southern mountains to Governor Taibu.

sentences.zh: 繼而川賊五家營至與合，欲東犯，台佈遣將扼之。

translations.literal: Then Sichuan rebels of the Five Households Camp arrived and joined them, intending to strike east; Taibu sent generals to block them.
translations.idiomatic: Then Sichuan rebels of the Five Households Camp arrived to join them and planned an eastern thrust; Taibu sent generals to block them.

sentences.zh: 賊趨鎮安，張世龍、張天倫為經略大兵所驅，亦奔鎮安，群賊皆注​​漢北山內。

translations.literal: The rebels moved on Zhen'an; Zhang Shilong and Zhang Tianlun, driven by the Pacification Commissioner's main force, also fled to Zhen'an, and all the rebel bands converged within the northern Han Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels moved on Zhen'an; Zhang Shilong and Zhang Tianlun, harried by the pacification commissioner's main force, also fled to Zhen'an, and rebel bands converged in the northern Han Mountains.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保追入老林，賊向商，雒，為楊遇春所破，始不敢東。

translations.literal: Eledengbao pursued into the old forest; the rebels turned toward Shang and Luo but were broken by Yang Yuchun and then dared not move east.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao pursued into the old forest; the rebels turned toward Shangzhou and Luonan but were defeated by Yang Yuchun and no longer dared advance east.

sentences.zh: 那彥成與會師鎮安。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng joined him and united the armies at Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng joined him and united forces at Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 商、雒賊折犯楚境。

translations.literal: The Shang and Luo rebels turned and raided Chu territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Shang and Luo rebels turned and raided Huguang territory.

sentences.zh: 上以軍事不得要領，召回京面詢方略，而高、馬二賊入川後益張，總兵施縉戰歿，詔斥那彥成縱賊，罷軍機、書房一切差使。

translations.literal: The emperor, finding the military effort lacked clear direction, recalled him to the capital to inquire strategy in person; meanwhile after Gao and Ma entered Sichuan they grew bolder, Brigadier Shi Jin died in battle, and an edict rebuked Na Yancheng for letting rebels escape and removed all his Grand Council and Southern Study posts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, finding the campaign lacked clear direction, recalled him to Beijing to discuss strategy in person; meanwhile, after Gao and Ma entered Sichuan they grew bolder, Brigadier Shi Jin was killed in battle, and an edict rebuked Na Yancheng for letting rebels escape and stripped him of all Grand Council and Southern Study appointments.

sentences.zh: 及至，召對，忤旨，再斥在陝漫無佈置，面詢兵事餉事，惟諉諸劫數未盡，且有忌額勒登保戰功意，褫尚書、講官、花翎，降翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: When he arrived and was summoned to audience he offended the throne; he was again rebuked for making no arrangements in Shaanxi, and when questioned on troops and supplies could only blame unfinished fate; moreover he was suspected of envying Eledengbao's battle honors—stripped of minister, lecturer, and peacock feather, demoted to Hanlin attendant lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On his arrival he was summoned to audience and gave offense; he was rebuked again for making no effective arrangements in Shaanxi, and when questioned on troops and supplies could only blame "unfinished fate"; he was also suspected of resenting Eledengbao's victories—stripped of his ministry, lectureship, and peacock feather, and demoted to Hanlin attendant lecturer.

sentences.zh: 歷少詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served as Junior Mentor and Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He served as junior mentor and Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 七年，赴江西按巡撫張誠基被劾事，未定讞，兩廣總督吉慶以剿會匪被譴自戕，命往鞫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he went to Jiangxi to investigate Governor Zhang Chengji's impeachment, the case undecided; Governor-General Jiqing of Guangdong, censured for suppressing secret-society bandits, committed suicide—he was ordered to conduct the inquest.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he went to Jiangxi to investigate the impeachment of Governor Zhang Chengji, the case still undecided; when Guangdong Governor-General Jiqing, censured for suppressing secret-society bandits, committed suicide, Na Yancheng was ordered to conduct the inquest.

sentences.zh: 八年，率提督孫全謀平會匪，條上善後，署吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he led Provincial Commander Sun Quanmou to pacify the secret-society bandits, memorialized measures for aftermath, and acted as Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he led Provincial Commander Sun Quanmou to pacify the secret-society bandits, submitted a program for pacification, and served as acting vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 擢禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 九年，复授軍機大臣，赴河南鞫獄，未畢，命署陝甘總督，治搜捕餘匪善後事宜，手詔戒之曰：「汝誠柱石之臣，有為有守。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was again appointed Grand Councilor and sent to Henan to try cases; before finishing he was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General to handle search for remnant bandits and aftermath, with a personal edict warning him: "You are truly a pillar of the state, capable and principled.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was again appointed to the Grand Council and sent to Henan to try cases; before he finished, he was ordered to serve as acting governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu to hunt remnant bandits and handle aftermath, with a personal edict warning him: "You are truly a pillar of the state—capable and principled.

sentences.zh: 惟自恃聰明，不求謀議，務資兼聽並觀之益，勿存五日京兆之見。

translations.literal: Only do not rely on your own cleverness and neglect to seek counsel; strive to gain the benefit of hearing many sides, and do not harbor the outlook of a five-day capital magistrate."
translations.idiomatic: Only do not trust too much in your own cleverness and neglect counsel; seek the benefit of hearing many views, and do not take the short-sighted outlook of a five-day capital magistrate."

sentences.zh: 」未幾，調授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred and appointed Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 廣東土匪勾結海寇為患，久不靖。

translations.literal: Guangdong bandits colluded with sea pirates to make trouble, long unrestful.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangdong, bandits colluded with sea pirates and unrest had persisted for years.

sentences.zh: 那彥成以兵不足用，乃招撫盜首黃正嵩、李崇玉，先後降者五千餘人，獎以千總外委銜及銀幣有差。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng, because troops were insufficient, then recruited and pacified bandit chiefs Huang Zhengsong and Li Chongyu; more than five thousand surrendered in succession and were rewarded with varying ranks of company officer and platoon leader and sums of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Finding his troops insufficient, Na Yancheng recruited and pacified bandit chiefs Huang Zhengsong and Li Chongyu; more than five thousand surrendered in succession and were rewarded with company-officer and platoon-leader ranks and silver in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 巡撫孫玉庭劾其賞盜，降藍翎侍衛，充伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Governor Sun Yuting impeached him for rewarding bandits; he was demoted to blue-button guardsman and appointed brigade commander at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Sun Yuting impeached him for rewarding bandits; he was demoted to blue-button guardsman and appointed brigade commander at Ili.

sentences.zh: 既而李崇玉檻送京師，訊得與正嵩皆受四品銜守備劄，褫職戍伊衛。

translations.literal: Later Li Chongyu was sent in the cangue to the capital; inquiry showed that he and Zhengsong had both received fourth-rank garrison-commander patents—office stripped and exiled to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Later Li Chongyu was escorted to the capital in the cangue; inquiry showed that he and Zhengsong had both received fourth-rank garrison-commander commissions—Na Yancheng was stripped of office and exiled to Ili.

sentences.zh: 十二年，复予二等侍衛，充領隊，調喀喇沙爾辦事大臣，又調西寧，平叛番，擢南河副總河。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was again given second-rank guardsman, served as brigade commander, was transferred to Karashahr resident commissioner, then to Xining where he pacified rebellious tribes, and was promoted to deputy director-general of the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was restored to second-rank guardsman, served as brigade commander, was transferred to Karashahr resident commissioner, then to Xining where he pacified rebellious tribes, and was promoted to deputy director-general of the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 以荷花塘漫口合而復決，降二等侍衛。

translations.literal: Because the Lotus Pond breach was closed and then burst again, he was demoted to second-rank guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: When the Lotus Pond breach was sealed and then burst again, he was demoted to second-rank guardsman.

sentences.zh: 歷喀喇沙爾、葉爾羌辦事大臣，喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He served as resident commissioner at Karashahr and Yarkand and as assistant military governor at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: He served as resident commissioner at Karashahr and Yarkand and as assistant military governor at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 十四年，复授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was again appointed Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was again appointed governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十八年，河南天理會教匪李文成等倡亂，陷滑縣，直隸、山東皆響應，林清糾黨犯禁門。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Henan Tiandihui sect rebels led by Li Wencheng and others rose, seized Huaxian, and Zhili and Shandong all responded; Lin Qing gathered a party and attacked the Forbidden Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Li Wencheng and other Tiandihui rebels in Henan rose in revolt, seized Huaxian, and drew responses from Zhili and Shandong; Lin Qing mustered followers and attacked the Forbidden Gate.

sentences.zh: 初，命總督溫承惠往剿，清既誅，乃發京兵，授那彥成欽差大臣，加都統銜，督師率楊遇春、楊芳等討之，迭詔責戰甚急。

translations.literal: At first Governor-General Wen Chenghui was ordered to suppress them; after Lin was executed, capital troops were dispatched, Na Yancheng was made Imperial Commissioner with commandant rank, directed the armies with Yang Yuchun, Yang Fang, and others to attack, and repeated edicts urgently pressed for battle.
translations.idiomatic: At first Governor-General Wen Chenghui was ordered to suppress them; after Lin Qing was killed, capital troops were sent out, Na Yancheng was made Imperial Commissioner with commandant rank to direct Yang Yuchun, Yang Fang, and others, and repeated edicts urgently pressed for action.

sentences.zh: 那彥成以小丑不足平，惟慮遁入太行，勢且蔓延，十月，至衛輝，合師而後進。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng held these petty foes not worth pacifying but feared they would escape into the Taihang Mountains and the trouble would spread; in the tenth month he reached Weihui, united the armies, and then advanced.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng regarded the rebels as trifling foes but feared they might slip into the Taihang Mountains and spread; in the tenth month he reached Weihui, united the armies, and then advanced.

sentences.zh: 賊踞桃源集、道口，與滑縣為犄角，連敗之於新鎮、丁欒集。

translations.literal: The rebels held Taoyuanji and Daokou in mutual support with Huaxian; they were repeatedly defeated at Xinzhen and Dingluanji.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held Taoyuanji and Daokou in mutual support with Huaxian; they were repeatedly defeated at Xinzhen and Dingluanji.

sentences.zh: 遇春擊破道口，殲賊萬餘，焚其巢；

translations.literal: Yuchun broke Daokou, destroyed more than ten thousand rebels, and burned their lair;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuchun broke Daokou, destroyed more than ten thousand rebels, and burned their lair;

sentences.zh: 尋破桃源集，追道口餘賊，抵滑縣。

translations.literal: Soon after he took Taoyuanji, pursued the Daokou remnant rebels, and reached Huaxian.
translations.idiomatic: He soon took Taoyuanji, pursued the Daokou remnant rebels, and reached Huaxian.

sentences.zh: 文成遁輝縣司寨，楊芳、德英阿追破之，文成自焚死。

translations.literal: Wencheng fled to Huixian Sizhai; Yang Fang and De'ying'a pursued and broke him; Wencheng burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wencheng fled to Sizhai in Huixian; Yang Fang and De'ying'a pursued and defeated him, and Wencheng burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 親督遇春等圍滑城數旬，以地雷攻拔之，獲首虜二萬餘。

translations.literal: He personally directed Yuchun and others in besieging Huacheng for several tens of days, stormed it with land mines, and captured more than twenty thousand leaders and captives.
translations.idiomatic: He personally directed Yang Yuchun and others in besieging Huacheng for several weeks, stormed it with land mines, and captured more than twenty thousand leaders and captives.

sentences.zh: 山東賊亦平。

translations.literal: The Shandong rebels were also pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong rebels were also pacified.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，加太子少保，封三等子爵，賜雙眼花翎，授直隸總督，賜祭其祖阿桂墓。

translations.literal: On news of victory he was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enfeoffed third-rank viscount, granted the double-eyed peacock feather, appointed Zhili Governor-General, and granted sacrifice at his grandfather Agui's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On news of victory he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enfeoffed as third-rank viscount, granted the double-eyed peacock feather, appointed governor-general of Zhili, and granted sacrifice at his grandfather Agui's tomb.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，坐前在陝甘移賑銀津貼腳價，褫職逮問，論大辟；

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, on account of earlier diverting relief silver in Shaanxi-Gansu to subsidize porter fees, he was stripped and arrested for trial, sentenced to death;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, for having diverted relief silver in Shaanxi-Gansu to subsidize porter fees, he was stripped of office and arrested, and sentenced to death;

sentences.zh: 繳完賠銀，改戍伊犁。

translations.literal: After paying the indemnity in full, the sentence was changed to exile to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: After paying the indemnity in full, the sentence was commuted to exile in Ili.

sentences.zh: 會丁母憂，詔援滑縣功，免發遣。

translations.literal: He happened to enter mourning for his mother; by edict, citing his Huaxian merit, exile was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered mourning for his mother; citing his service at Huaxian, the court remitted his exile by edict.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，授翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Hanlin attendant lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Hanlin attendant lecturer.

sentences.zh: 歷理籓院、吏部、刑部尚書，授內大臣。

translations.literal: He served as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Personnel, and Justice, and was appointed Grand Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He served as minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, the Board of Personnel, and the Board of Punishments, and was appointed grand minister.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，青海野番甫定复擾，命那彥成往按，遂授陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang the wild tribes of Qinghai, just pacified, again disturbed; Na Yancheng was ordered to investigate and was then appointed Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang the wild tribes of Qinghai, barely pacified, rose again; Na Yancheng was sent to investigate and was then appointed governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 驅私住河北番族回河南原牧，嚴定約束，緝治漢奸，乃漸平。

translations.literal: He drove tribes privately dwelling north of the river back to their original pastures in Henan, strictly fixed regulations, and suppressed Han collaborators—then it gradually became calm.
translations.idiomatic: He drove tribes that had encroached north of the Yellow River back to their original pastures in Henan, tightened regulations, and suppressed Han collaborators, and the region gradually calmed.

sentences.zh: 五年，調直隸。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 七年，回疆四城既复，命為欽差大臣，往治善後事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, after the four Muslim frontier cities were recovered, he was appointed Imperial Commissioner to handle aftermath.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, after the four frontier cities were recovered, he was appointed Imperial Commissioner to handle pacification and aftermath.

sentences.zh: 先後奏定章程，革各城積弊。

translations.literal: He memorialized regulations in succession and reformed long-standing abuses in each city.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted regulations in succession and reformed long-standing abuses in each city.

sentences.zh: 諸領隊、辦事大臣歲終受考覈於參贊大臣，又總考覈於伊犁將軍，互相糾察；

translations.literal: All brigade and resident commissioners at year's end received examination from the assistant military governor, and in turn aggregate examination from the Ili general, with mutual oversight;
translations.idiomatic: All brigade and resident commissioners were examined yearly by the assistant military governor and then collectively by the Ili general, with mutual oversight;

sentences.zh: 增其廉俸，許其攜眷，久其任期。

translations.literal: Their integrity stipends were increased, they were permitted to bring families, and their terms of office were lengthened.
translations.idiomatic: Their integrity stipends were increased, they were permitted to bring their families, and their terms of office were lengthened.

sentences.zh: 印房章京由京揀選，不用駐防。

translations.literal: Chancery clerks of the seal office were selected from the capital and garrison troops were not used.
translations.idiomatic: Seal-office clerks were selected from Beijing rather than from garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 除伯克賄補之弊，嚴制資格，保舉迴避。

translations.literal: The abuse of buying bek posts was eliminated, qualifications were strictly controlled, and recommendation with avoidance rules applied.
translations.idiomatic: He eliminated the abuse of buying bek posts, tightened qualifications, and applied rules for recommendation and avoidance.

sentences.zh: 五城叛產歸官收租，歲糧五萬六千餘石，支兵餉外，餘萬八千石為酌增各官養廉鹽米銀之用，有餘則變價解阿克蘇採買儲倉。

translations.literal: Rebel property of the five cities was taken by the state for rent; annual grain was more than fifty-six thousand shi; beyond military pay, the remaining eighteen thousand shi were to augment officials' integrity stipends for salt and grain silver; surplus was sold for cash and sent to Aksu for purchase and storage.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel property in the five cities was confiscated for state rent; annual grain exceeded fifty-six thousand shi; beyond military rations, the remaining eighteen thousand shi were allotted to augment officials' integrity stipends; surplus grain was sold and sent to Aksu for purchase and storage.

sentences.zh: 改建城垣，增卡堡，練戍兵。

translations.literal: City walls were rebuilt, pass forts increased, and garrison troops drilled.
translations.idiomatic: City walls were rebuilt, frontier forts added, and garrison troops drilled.

sentences.zh: 浩罕為逋逃藪，所屬八城，安集延即其一。

translations.literal: Kokand was a haven for fugitives; of its eight subject cities, Andijan was one.
translations.idiomatic: Kokand was a haven for fugitives; of its eight subject cities, Andijan was one.

sentences.zh: 嚴禁茶葉、大黃出卡。

translations.literal: Tea and rhubarb were strictly forbidden to pass the frontier posts.
translations.idiomatic: Export of tea and rhubarb beyond the frontier posts was strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 盡逐內地流夷，收撫各布魯特，待其款關求貢，然後撫之。

translations.literal: All stray foreigners in the interior were expelled; various Kirghiz were gathered in allegiance; only when they sincerely came to the passes to seek tribute were they then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: All stray foreigners in the interior were expelled; various Kirghiz were brought under allegiance; only when they sincerely came to the passes to seek tribute were they then received.

sentences.zh: 詔悉允行。

translations.literal: An edict approved all for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved all measures for implementation.

sentences.zh: 張格爾既誅，加太子太保，賜紫韁、雙眼花翎，繪像紫光閣，列功臣之末。

translations.literal: After Jahangir Khoja was executed, [Na Yancheng] was advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted purple bridle and double-eyed peacock feather, his portrait painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor, listed last among meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: After Jahangir Khoja was executed, he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted the purple bridle and double-eyed peacock feather, had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and was listed last among the meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 浩罕匿張格爾妻孥，詐使人投書伺隙。

translations.literal: Kokand harbored Jahangir Khoja's wife and children and sent agents under false pretenses with letters to watch for openings.
translations.idiomatic: Kokand harbored the wife and children of Jahangir Khoja and sent agents under false pretenses with letters to watch for an opening.

sentences.zh: 那彥成禁不使與內地交接，絕其貿易。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng forbade contact with the interior and cut off trade.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng forbade contact with the interior and cut off trade.

sentences.zh: 九年，使人出卡搜求逆屬，上慮其邀功生事，召還京，仍回直隸總督任。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he sent men beyond the passes to search for rebel kin; the emperor, fearing he would seek merit and stir trouble, recalled him to the capital and restored him to the Zhili governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he sent men beyond the passes to hunt rebel kin; the emperor, fearing he would court merit and stir trouble, recalled him to Beijing and restored him as governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 未及兩歲，西陲復不靖。

translations.literal: Before two years had passed, the western frontier was again unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Within less than two years the western frontier was again unsettled.

sentences.zh: 論者謂那彥成驅內地安集延，沒貲產、絕貿易所致。

translations.literal: Commentators said it was because Na Yancheng drove Andijan people from the interior, confiscated property, and cut off trade.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators blamed Na Yancheng for driving Andijan merchants from the interior, confiscating their property, and severing trade.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔斥誤國肇釁，褫職。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict rebuked him for misleading the state and provoking trouble, and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year an edict rebuked him for misleading the state and provoking conflict, and stripped him of office.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒，宣宗追念平教匪功，賜尚書銜，依例賜卹，諡文毅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he died; the Daoguang Emperor, recalling his merit in pacifying sect rebels, granted ministerial rank, mourning gifts by precedent, posthumous title Wenyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he died; the Daoguang Emperor, recalling his service in pacifying the sect rebels, granted ministerial rank, mourning benefits by precedent, and the posthumous title Wenyi.

sentences.zh: 那彥成遇事有為，工文翰，好士，雖屢起屢躓，中外想望風采。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng was enterprising in affairs, skilled in letters, fond of scholars; though he rose and fell repeatedly, court and country alike looked to his bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng was enterprising, skilled in letters, and fond of scholars; though he rose and fell repeatedly, men at court and beyond still looked to him with respect.

sentences.zh: 子容安、容照。

translations.literal: His sons were Rong'an and Rongzhao.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Rong'an and Rongzhao.

sentences.zh: 容安，廕戶部主事，襲子爵。

translations.literal: Rong'an inherited a Ministry of Revenue clerkship by privilege and inherited the viscountcy.
translations.idiomatic: Rong'an inherited a clerkship in the Ministry of Revenue by privilege and succeeded to the viscountcy.

sentences.zh: 歷侍衛、副都統。

translations.literal: He served as guardsman and vice commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He served as guardsman and vice commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 從長齡徵回疆有功，歷伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Following Chang Ling in the Muslim frontier campaign he had merit and served as Ili Assistant Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied Chang Ling on the Muslim frontier campaign with distinction and served as assistant military governor of Ili.

sentences.zh: 亂事再起，容安率兵四千五百赴援，抵阿克蘇，遷延不進。

translations.literal: When rebellion rose again, Rong'an led four thousand five hundred troops to aid, reached Aksu, and delayed without advancing.
translations.idiomatic: When rebellion broke out again, Rong'an led forty-five hundred men to the relief, reached Aksu, and lingered without advancing.

sentences.zh: 由和闐繞道，又分兵烏什，致喀、英二城圍久不解。

translations.literal: Taking a detour via Khotan and also dividing troops to Ush, he caused the sieges of Kashgar and Yengisar to remain long unresolved.
translations.idiomatic: By detouring through Khotan and splitting forces to Ush, he left the sieges of Kashgar and Yengisar unresolved for months.

sentences.zh: 褫職逮治，讞大辟。

translations.literal: Stripped of office and seized for trial, sentencing called for death.
translations.idiomatic: He was stripped of office and arrested; the verdict was death.

sentences.zh: 尋以二城未失，從寬改監候，罰繳和闐軍需，貸死戍吉林。

translations.literal: Soon because the two cities had not fallen, leniency changed it to imprisonment awaiting execution, fined to pay Khotan military supplies, death commuted to garrison service in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Because neither city had fallen, the sentence was eased to imprisonment awaiting execution; he was fined for Khotan military supplies and his death sentence was commuted to exile garrison duty in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 父喪，釋還。

translations.literal: On his father's mourning, he was released to return.
translations.idiomatic: On his father's death he was released to return home.

sentences.zh: 數年卒。

translations.literal: Several years later he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died a few years later.

sentences.zh: 容照，以大臣子予侍衛。

translations.literal: Rongzhao, as a minister's son, was granted guardsman status.
translations.idiomatic: Rongzhao, as a minister's son, was appointed imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 累擢內閣學士。
