translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in repeated promotions to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 亦從征回疆，隨父治善後。

translations.literal: Also followed the Muslim frontier campaign and aided his father in handling aftermath.
translations.idiomatic: He too joined the Muslim frontier campaign and assisted his father in pacification work.

sentences.zh: 擢理籓院侍郎。

translations.literal: Promoted to vice president of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice president of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 容安既獲罪，襲子爵。

translations.literal: After Rong'an had been convicted, [Rongzhao] inherited the viscountcy.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong'an was condemned, he succeeded to the viscountcy.

sentences.zh: 繼因那彥成被譴，同褫職。

translations.literal: Subsequently because Na Yancheng was rebuked, [he] was likewise stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He was later stripped of office along with Na Yancheng when the latter was punished.

sentences.zh: 起，歷馬蘭鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Restored, he served as commander at Mulan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Restored to service, he served as commander of Mulan Garrison.

sentences.zh: 治獄失入，复褫爵職。

translations.literal: In handling a legal case he erred on sentencing and again lost rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: A judicial error in sentencing cost him his rank and office again.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛從揚威將軍奕經防廣東。

translations.literal: As guardsman he followed the Expel-Awry General Yijing in defending Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: As guardsman he accompanied Commissioner Yijing in the defense of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 充庫倫辦事大臣，復為馬蘭鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Served as resident commissioner at Urga and again as commander at Mulan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He served as resident commissioner at Urga and again as commander of Mulan Garrison.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，從尚書恩華剿捻匪有功，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng reign, following Minister En Hua in suppressing Nian bandits he had merit and received vice commandant-in-chief rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianfeng reign he distinguished himself suppressing Nian bandits under Minister En Hua and was given vice commandant-in-chief rank.

sentences.zh: 以疾回京，卒，賜血卩。

translations.literal: Returned to the capital on illness, died, and was granted mourning perquisites.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Beijing on account of illness, died, and was granted mourning benefits by precedent.

sentences.zh: 孫鄂素，襲爵。

translations.literal: His grandson Esu inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Esu inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 玉麟，字子振，哈達納喇氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Yu Lin, style name Zizhen, of the Hadanara clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lin, whose style was Zizhen, was of the Hadanara clan, a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the sixtieth year of Qianlong, selected Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the sixtieth year of the Qianlong reign, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，三遷為祭酒。

translations.literal: Early in Jiaqing, thrice promoted to become Libationer.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign he was promoted three times until he became Libationer of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 歷詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: Served as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 纂修實錄久，特詔充總纂，奏事列名總裁後。

translations.literal: Long compiling veritable records, specially ordered to serve as chief compiler; when reporting affairs his name was listed after the chief directors.
translations.idiomatic: After long service compiling the veritable records, he was specially ordered to serve as chief compiler; when reporting to the throne his name was listed after the chief directors.

sentences.zh: 入直上書房。

translations.literal: Entered the Southern Study attached to the throne room.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Southern Study attached to the throne room.

sentences.zh: 歷禮部、吏部侍郎，典會試。

translations.literal: Served as vice ministers in the Ministries of Rites and Personnel and presided over metropolitan examinations.
translations.idiomatic: He served as vice minister in the Ministries of Rites and Personnel and presided over metropolitan examinations.

sentences.zh: 奉使鞫安徽壽州獄，及湖北官銀匠侵虧錢糧事，大吏並被嚴譴。

translations.literal: Commissioned to try the Anhui Shouzhou case and Hubei silversmiths' embezzlement of grain taxes; high officials were all severely rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioned to try the Shouzhou case in Anhui and the Hubei silversmiths' embezzlement of grain taxes, he secured severe rebukes for the senior officials involved.

sentences.zh: 後歷赴湖南、江西、直隸、河南按事，時稱公正。

translations.literal: Later he was repeatedly sent to Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhili, and Henan to investigate cases, and was called fair at the time.
translations.idiomatic: He was later sent repeatedly to Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhili, and Henan to investigate cases, and at the time was praised for his fairness.

sentences.zh: 十二年，督安徽學政，調江蘇。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he supervised Anhui education and was transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he supervised education in Anhui and was transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 十六年，兼右翼總兵。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, concurrently Right Wing commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he also served as Right Wing commander.

sentences.zh: 坐吏部銓序有誤，奪職。

translations.literal: Censured for errors in Ministry of Personnel ranking order, office taken.
translations.idiomatic: He lost office after being censured for errors in the Ministry of Personnel's ranking order.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授內閣學士，兼護軍統領、左翼總兵，遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Before long appointed Grand Secretariat academician, concurrently commander of the Guard Corps and Left Wing commander, promoted to vice minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Grand Secretariat academician, concurrently commander of the Guard Corps and Left Wing commander, and promoted to vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十八年八月，車駕自熱河回蹕，迎至白澗，先還京。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighteenth year the imperial carriage returned from Rehe; he welcomed it to Baijian and returned first to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eighteenth year he welcomed the imperial carriage returning from Rehe as far as Baijian, then went back to Beijing ahead of it.

sentences.zh: 會林清逆黨犯禁門，率所部擊捕；

translations.literal: When Lin Qing's rebel faction stormed the Forbidden Gate, he led his troops to attack and capture them;
translations.idiomatic: When Lin Qing's rebels stormed the Forbidden Gate, he led his troops to attack and capture them;

sentences.zh: 坐門禁懈弛，褫職。

translations.literal: censured for lax gate security, stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: yet he was censured for lax gate security and stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 十九年，予三等侍衛，赴葉爾羌辦事。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, given third-rank guardsman, sent to Yarkand as resident commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was given third-rank guardsman and sent to Yarkand as resident commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，加副都統銜，充駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, granted vice commandant rank, served as Resident Commissioner in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was given vice commandant rank and served as resident commissioner in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 歷左翼總兵、鑲白旗漢軍副都統，遷左都御史，禮部、吏部、兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Served as Left Wing commander, vice commandant of the Bordered White Banner Chinese Banner forces, promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief, ministers of Rites, Personnel, and War.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Left Wing commander and vice commandant of the Bordered White Banner Chinese forces, then rose to Left Censor-in-Chief and minister of Rites, Personnel, and War in succession.

sentences.zh: 道光四年，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daoguang, ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Daoguang he was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 六年，回疆亂起，西四城皆陷。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Muslim frontier rebellion rose and all four western cities fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year rebellion broke out on the Muslim frontier and all four western cities fell.

sentences.zh: 阿克蘇辦事大臣長清獨能固守卻賊，先由玉麟論薦，詔特嘉之，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Aksu Resident Commissioner Chang Qing alone could hold firm and repel rebels; Yu Lin had first recommended him in memorial; an edict specially praised and granted peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Aksu resident commissioner Chang Qing alone held firm and repelled the rebels; Yu Lin had first recommended him in memorial, and an edict specially praised him and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 七年，兼翰林院掌院學士，充上書房總師傅，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, concurrently Hanlin Academy chancellor, chief tutor of the Southern Study, made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became Hanlin Academy chancellor and chief tutor of the Southern Study and was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 八年，回疆既定，晉太子太保，繪像紫光閣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Muslim frontier pacified, advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after the Muslim frontier was pacified, he was advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 上方廑顧西陲，以玉麟悉邊務，九年，特命出為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: The emperor was anxious about the western frontier; because Yu Lin knew border affairs thoroughly, in the ninth year he was specially ordered out as Ili General.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply concerned for the western frontier; because Yu Lin knew border affairs thoroughly, in the ninth year he was specially appointed Ili general.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「浩罕將作不靖，請緩南路換防。

translations.literal: Memorial said: "Kokand is about to make trouble; request to slow rotation of southern-route garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Kokand is about to stir trouble; I request that rotation of the southern-route garrisons be slowed.

sentences.zh: 阿坦台、汰劣克屢請投順，包藏禍心，添巡邊兵以備禦。

translations.literal: Atantai and Taulik repeatedly seek submission but harbor evil intent; add frontier patrol troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Atantai and Taulik have repeatedly sought to submit while harboring hostile intent; add frontier patrol troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 伊薩​​克忠勇能事，責令乘機謀之。

translations.literal: Yisak is loyal, brave, and capable; charge him to take opportunity to deal with them.
translations.idiomatic: Yisak is loyal, brave, and capable; charge him to seize the opportunity to deal with them.

sentences.zh: 近夷布呼等愛曼恭順，重賞以固其心，則卡外動靜俱悉。

translations.literal: Nearby tribes Buqu and others' aymans are respectful; reward them heavily to secure loyalty, then all movements beyond the passes will be known.
translations.idiomatic: The aymans of nearby tribes such as Buqu are respectful; reward them generously to secure their loyalty, and all movements beyond the passes will be known.

sentences.zh: 」詔如議行，並令喀什噶爾參贊大臣札隆阿為之備。

translations.literal: " Edict approved as proposed, and ordered Kashgar Assistant Military Governor Zhalong'a to make preparations.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict approved the proposal and ordered Kashgar assistant military governor Zhalong'a to make preparations.

sentences.zh: 札隆阿誤信汰劣克等，不之疑也。

translations.literal: Zhalong'a mistakenly trusted Taulik and others and did not suspect them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalong'a mistakenly trusted Taulik and the others and did not suspect them.

sentences.zh: 十年秋，安集延果引浩罕內犯，喀什噶爾幫辦大臣塔斯哈率兵出禦，遇伏陷歿。

translations.literal: Autumn of the tenth year, Andijan indeed led Kokand to invade inward; Kashgar Assistant Minister Taskha led troops out to resist, met ambush and perished.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the tenth year Andijan indeed led Kokand in an invasion; Kashgar assistant commissioner Taskha led troops out to resist, was ambushed, and perished.

sentences.zh: 札隆阿將棄城退守阿克蘇，玉麟急疏聞，請責長清等速籌糧儲，哈豐阿速進攻，發伊犁兵四千五百名，令容安率之赴援。

translations.literal: Zhalong'a was about to abandon the city and retreat to Aksu; Yu Lin urgently memorialized, asked to hold Chang Qing and others to quickly prepare grain stores, Ha Feng'e to attack quickly, despatched four thousand five hundred Ili troops under Rong'an to aid.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalong'a was about to abandon the city and fall back on Aksu; Yu Lin urgently memorialized the throne, demanding that Chang Qing and others quickly stock grain, that Ha Feng'e advance at once, and despatching forty-five hundred Ili troops under Rong'an to the relief.

sentences.zh: 容安至阿克蘇，與長清議，中途有朵蘭回子梗阻，令哈豐阿、孝順岱由和闐草地進兵。

translations.literal: Rong'an reached Aksu, consulted Chang Qing; midway Dolan Hui blocked the route, ordered Ha Feng'e and Xiaoshundai to advance via the Khotan pasture route.
translations.idiomatic: Rong'an reached Aksu and consulted Chang Qing; because Dolan Muslims blocked the route midway, he ordered Ha Feng'e and Xiaoshundai to advance by the Khotan pasture road.

sentences.zh: 玉麟疏劾曰：「喀、英兩城被困兩月，賊勢尚單，易於援剿，由大路直赴葉爾羌，二城之圍自解。

translations.literal: Yu Lin memorialized impeachment saying: "Kashgar and Yengisar have been besieged two months; rebel strength is still slight, easy to relieve and suppress; by the main road straight to Yarkand, the two cities' sieges will resolve themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lin memorialized in impeachment: "Kashgar and Yengisar have been besieged for two months; rebel strength is still slight and easy to relieve; by the main road straight to Yarkand, the sieges of both cities will lift of themselves.

sentences.zh: 迂道和闐，須一月方至，賊勢漸厚，哈豐阿軍未必得力。

translations.literal: Detouring via Khotan requires a month to arrive; rebel strength will gradually thicken; Ha Feng'e's army may not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Detouring through Khotan will take a month to arrive, rebel strength will grow, and Ha Feng'e's force may not prevail.

sentences.zh: 阿克蘇現集兵不下萬人，僅以三千人繞路進發，留兵坐糜餉糧，實屬非計。

translations.literal: At Aksu troops now gathered are not fewer than ten thousand; only three thousand sent by detour while troops sit wasting rations—truly no plan.
translations.idiomatic: At Aksu nearly ten thousand troops are already assembled, yet only three thousand are sent by a detour while the rest sit wasting rations—this is truly no plan at all.

sentences.zh: 札催十數次，該大臣等始以糧運遷延，後又稱蒙兵、民遣皆不足恃。

translations.literal: Memorials urged more than ten times; those grandees at first cited delayed grain transport, later also said Mongol troops and local levies were all unreliable.
translations.idiomatic: He urged them in memorial more than ten times; those grandees at first pleaded delayed grain transport, then claimed that Mongol troops and local levies were all unreliable.

sentences.zh: 計程裹糧二十日足用，後路轉運已源源而來。

translations.literal: By route calculation, rations carried for twenty days suffice; rear supply transport already comes in streams.
translations.idiomatic: By route calculation twenty days' carried rations suffice, and rear supply transport is already arriving in steady streams.

sentences.zh: 前年克復四城，民遣得力，渾巴什河之捷，土爾扈特出力較多。

translations.literal: The year before last in recovering the four cities, local levies were effective; at the Hunbash River victory, Torghut forces contributed more.
translations.idiomatic: When the four cities were recovered the year before last, local levies proved effective; at the victory on the Hunbash River the Torghuts contributed the greater part.

sentences.zh: 近日璧昌以少勝眾，豈沿邊零匪轉不能就地殲除？

translations.literal: Recently Bichang with few overcame many—can scattered frontier bandits then not be destroyed on the spot?
translations.idiomatic: Only recently Bichang defeated a larger force with fewer men—are scattered frontier bandits then beyond destroying on the spot?

sentences.zh: 請將長清等嚴行申飭。

translations.literal: Request to strictly rebuke Chang Qing and others.
translations.idiomatic: I request that Chang Qing and the others be sternly rebuked.

sentences.zh: 」上韙其言，仍促哈豐阿進兵。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words but still urged Ha Feng'e to advance.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved his argument but still urged Ha Feng'e to advance.

sentences.zh: 及長齡督楊芳、胡超等大兵至喀、英二城，賊已遠遁。

translations.literal: When Chang Ling directed Yang Fang, Hu Chao, and great armies to Kashgar and Yengisar, rebels had already fled far.
translations.idiomatic: By the time Chang Ling led Yang Fang, Hu Chao, and the main armies to Kashgar and Yengisar, the rebels had already fled far away.

sentences.zh: 玉麟疏言：「賊勢渙散，現調官兵不止四萬，月需糧萬五千石，運費十餘萬兩。

translations.literal: Yu Lin memorialized: "Rebel strength is scattered; troops now mobilized exceed forty thousand; monthly grain need is fifteen thousand shi, transport costs more than one hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lin memorialized: "Rebel strength is scattered; more than forty thousand regular troops are now mobilized, requiring fifteen thousand shi of grain a month and transport costs of more than one hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 請停止續調四川、陝、甘兵，並飭回疆各城採買糧餉，較之戈壁轉輸，節省不止倍蓰。

translations.literal: Request to stop further mobilizing Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Gansu troops, and order each Muslim frontier city to purchase grain and pay—compared with Gobi transport, savings exceed more than double.
translations.idiomatic: I request that further mobilization of troops from Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Gansu be stopped and that each Muslim frontier city be ordered to purchase grain and pay locally; compared with transport across the Gobi, the savings would be more than double.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 初張格爾之就擒也，回子郡王銜貝子伊薩克實誘致，諸夷忌之，亂起，兵民謀劫掠，事泄，誅首犯，逐流民。

translations.literal: When Jahangir Khoja was first captured, Hui prince-rank Beizi Yisak truly lured him in; various tribes envied him; when rebellion rose, soldiers and people plotted plunder; exposed, chief offenders were executed and stray people expelled.
translations.idiomatic: When Jahangir Khoja was first captured, the Hui prince-rank beizi Yisak had in fact lured him in; various tribes envied him. When rebellion broke out, soldiers and civilians plotted plunder; the plot was exposed, the chief offenders executed, and stray people expelled.

sentences.zh: 怨者譌言伊薩克通賊，遂圍劫其家，並殺避亂回眾二百餘人。

translations.literal: The resentful spread slander that Yisak communicated with rebels, then besieged and plundered his house, also killing more than two hundred Hui people who had fled the turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Malcontents spread slander that Yisak was in league with the rebels, besieged and plundered his household, and also killed more than two hundred Hui civilians who had taken refuge from the fighting.

sentences.zh: 札隆阿不能制，反附和劾囚之。

translations.literal: Zhalong'a could not control it and instead joined in impeaching and imprisoning him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalong'a could not control the mob and instead joined in impeaching and imprisoning him.

sentences.zh: 玉麟以伊薩克身膺王封，助亂得不償失，子孫在阿克蘇，家業在庫車，豈無顧慮？

translations.literal: Yu Lin held that Yisak bore princely rank, aiding rebellion would not repay the cost; his descendants were in Aksu, family estates in Kucha—would he have no concern?
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lin argued that Yisak held princely rank and would gain nothing by aiding rebellion; his descendants were in Aksu and his estates in Kucha—would he not have scruples?

sentences.zh: 疏陳其可疑，命偕長齡會鞫，得札隆阿懼罪欲殺之以掩跡，及委員章京等捏奏迎合誣證狀，札隆阿以下坐罪有差，复伊薩克爵職，回眾大服。

translations.literal: Memorial stated his doubts; ordered jointly with Chang Ling to try; found Zhalong'a feared guilt and wished to kill him to cover tracks, and staff clerks fabricated memorials to suit and falsely testified; Zhalong'a and below punished in varying degrees, Yisak's rank and office restored, Hui people greatly submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized his doubts; Yu Lin was ordered to try the case jointly with Chang Ling. It was found that Zhalong'a, fearing guilt, had wished to kill Yisak to cover his tracks, and staff clerks had fabricated memorials and false testimony to suit him. Zhalong'a and his subordinates were punished in varying degrees, Yisak's rank and office were restored, and the Hui populace was deeply impressed.

sentences.zh: 時諸臣議回疆事宜，玉麟上疏曰：「閱固原提督楊芳添兵招佃奏稿，稱四川總督鄂山有請西四城改照土司之議。

translations.literal: At the time various ministers debated Muslim frontier affairs; Yu Lin memorialized: "Having read Guyuan Commander Yang Fang's draft on adding troops and recruiting colonists, it says Sichuan Governor-General E Shan has proposed treating the four western cities like native chieftaincies.
translations.idiomatic: At the time ministers were debating Muslim frontier policy; Yu Lin memorialized: "Having read the draft memorial of Guyuan commander Yang Fang on adding troops and recruiting colonists, it states that Sichuan governor-general E Shan has proposed treating the four western cities like native chieftaincies.

sentences.zh: 伏思回疆自入版圖，設官駐兵，不惟西四城為東道籓籬，南八城為西陲保障，即前後藏及西北沿邊蒙古、番子部落，皆賴以鞏固。

translations.literal: Reflecting: since the Muslim frontier entered the map, officials and garrisons were set—not only are the four western cities the eastern route's screen, the eight southern cities the western frontier's bulwark; even front and rear Tibet and northwestern border Mongol and tribal peoples all rely on this to be secured.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting on this: since the Muslim frontier entered the empire, officials and garrisons have been stationed there. The four western cities are not only the screen of the eastern route; the eight southern cities are the bulwark of the western frontier. Even Tibet and the Mongol and tribal peoples along the northwestern border all depend on this region for their security.

sentences.zh: 若西四城不設官兵，僅令回人守土，誠恐回性無恆，又最畏布魯特強橫，轉瞬即為外夷所有，則阿克蘇又將為極邊矣。

translations.literal: If the four western cities have no official troops and only Hui people guard the land, truly fearing Hui nature is inconstant and they most fear Kirghiz strength and violence—in an instant it will belong to outer tribes, then Aksu again becomes the outermost edge.
translations.idiomatic: If no official troops are stationed in the four western cities and only the Hui are left to guard the land, I truly fear that, given the inconstancy of the Hui and their dread of Kirghiz power, the region would in an instant fall to foreign tribes and Aksu would again become the outermost frontier.

sentences.zh: 其迤東之庫車、喀喇沙爾、吐魯番、哈密等城，必至漸不安堵。

translations.literal: The cities eastward—Kucha, Karashahr, Turfan, Hami—will necessarily grow gradually unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: The cities farther east—Kucha, Karashahr, Turfan, and Hami—would in turn grow unsettled.

sentences.zh: 以形勢論，脣亡則齒寒；

translations.literal: By strategic situation, when the lips perish the teeth grow cold;
translations.idiomatic: In strategic terms, when the lips are gone the teeth grow cold;

sentences.zh: 以地利論，喀什噶爾、葉爾羌、和闐三處為回疆殷實之區。

translations.literal: by terrain, Kashgar, Yarkand, and Khotan are the Muslim frontier's wealthy districts.
translations.idiomatic: in terms of terrain, Kashgar, Yarkand, and Khotan are the wealthiest districts of the Muslim frontier.

sentences.zh: 舍沃壤而守瘠土，是藉寇兵而齎盜糧也。

translations.literal: Abandoning fertile soil to guard barren land is to lend the enemy troops and carry rations for robbers.
translations.idiomatic: To abandon fertile land and hold barren soil is to arm the enemy and provision thieves.

sentences.zh: 楊芳所謂守善於棄，實不易之論。

translations.literal: What Yang Fang calls holding being better than abandoning is truly a hard-won doctrine.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fang's doctrine that holding territory is better than abandoning it is indeed sound and not easily refuted.

sentences.zh: 至請將喀什噶爾參贊移遷阿克蘇，殊非善計。

translations.literal: As for requesting to move the Kashgar assistant military governor to Aksu, it is by no means a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: As for the proposal to move the Kashgar assistant military governor to Aksu, it is by no means a sound plan.

sentences.zh: 該處幅員狹隘，不足為重鎮。

translations.literal: That place's territory is narrow and cramped, insufficient to be a major stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: That place is too narrow in extent to serve as a major stronghold.

sentences.zh: 且距喀城二千里，有鞭長不及之患。

translations.literal: Moreover it is two thousand li from Kashgar city, with the affliction that the whip cannot reach.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover it lies two thousand li from Kashgar, with the affliction that authority cannot reach so far.

sentences.zh: 其所陳招佃通商各條，則為治邊良法，請用之。

translations.literal: His stated articles on recruiting colonists and opening trade are good methods for governing the frontier; request to employ them.
translations.idiomatic: His proposals on recruiting colonists and opening trade, however, are sound methods of frontier governance and should be adopted.

sentences.zh: 」於是詔髮長齡密陳十條及中外奏議，交玉麟悉心籌畫。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict sent Chang Ling's ten secret articles and court and frontier memorials, entrusting Yu Lin to plan with full care.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon an edict sent Chang Ling's ten confidential articles and memorials from court and frontier alike to Yu Lin for careful planning.

sentences.zh: 十一年，偕長齡會疏，上定以參贊大臣移駐葉爾羌，暨善後諸政，具詳長齡傳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, jointly memorializing with Chang Ling, the court fixed moving the assistant military governor to Yarkand, with all pacification policies—detailed in Chang Ling's biography.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he and Chang Ling submitted a joint memorial; the court fixed that the assistant military governor should be stationed at Yarkand, along with other pacification measures detailed in Chang Ling's biography.

sentences.zh: 十二年，事定，回伊犁，調劑番戍官兵以均勞逸。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, affairs settled, returned to Ili, adjusted frontier garrison troops to balance labor and rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, after affairs were settled, he returned to Ili and adjusted frontier garrison troops to balance their burdens.

sentences.zh: 惠遠城南瀕河，定歲修之例；

translations.literal: South of Huiyuan city bordering the river, fixed the precedent of annual repairs;
translations.idiomatic: South of Huiyuan city, along the riverbank, he established the precedent of annual repairs;

sentences.zh: 以待種之地租給回民，收租充兵食，並為贍孤寡備差操諸用。

translations.literal: rented land awaiting cultivation to Hui people, collected rent for military rations, and also to support widows and orphans and prepare for corvée and service uses.
translations.idiomatic: rented out land awaiting cultivation to Hui tenants, collected rent for military rations, and also to support widows and orphans and meet corvée and service needs.

sentences.zh: 拓敬業官學學舍，創建文廟。

translations.literal: Expanded the Jingye official school buildings and founded a Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: He expanded the buildings of the Jingye official school and founded a Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 宣宗特頒扁額以重其事，邊徼士風漸蒸蒸焉。

translations.literal: The Daoguang Emperor specially issued a plaque to honor the matter; frontier scholarly custom gradually flourished.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoguang Emperor specially issued a commemorative plaque to honor the undertaking, and scholarly custom on the frontier gradually flourished.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命回京，以特依順保代之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, ordered to return to the capital; Te Yishunbao replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was ordered back to Beijing and Te Yishunbao was appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 行至陝西，卒於途次。

translations.literal: Reaching Shaanxi, died on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: He reached Shaanxi and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 上聞震悼，優詔賜卹，贈太保，入祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: The emperor on hearing was shaken and grieved, granted favored edict mourning gifts, posthumously made Grand Guardian, entered worship in the Hall of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply grieved on hearing the news, granted favored mourning benefits by edict, posthumously made him Grand Guardian, and ordered his entry into the Hall of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 柩至京，親臨賜奠，諡文恭。

translations.literal: When the coffin reached the capital, the emperor personally came to grant libation; posthumous title Wengong.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin reached Beijing the emperor came in person to offer libation; his posthumous title was Wengong.

sentences.zh: 伊犁請祠祀，允之。

translations.literal: Ili requested temple worship; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Ili requested that he be worshipped in a local temple, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 特依順保，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Te Yishunbao, of the Niohuru clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Te Yishunbao was of the Niohuru clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 由吉林前鋒長從征廓爾喀，有功。

translations.literal: From Jilin vanguard chief followed the Gurkha campaign with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a Jilin vanguard chief, he joined the Gurkha campaign with distinction.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中，從長齡剿教匪，屢破高天升、馬學禮，賜號安成額巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing, followed Chang Ling suppressing sect rebels, repeatedly defeated Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli, granted the title Ancheng'e Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiaqing reign he followed Chang Ling in suppressing the sect rebels, repeatedly defeated Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli, and was granted the title Ancheng'e Batulu.

sentences.zh: 累擢甘肅西寧鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to Gansu Xining Garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in repeated promotions to commander of the Xining Garrison in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從那彥成討滑縣教匪，力戰，數破賊，克司寨，殲首逆李文成，克滑縣，執賊渠，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he followed Na Yancheng in suppressing the sect rebels at Huaxian, fought fiercely, repeatedly defeated the rebels, captured Sizhai, destroyed the chief rebel Li Wencheng, captured Huacheng, seized rebel leaders, and was granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1813) he followed Na Yancheng against the Huaxian sect rebels, fought fiercely and repeatedly defeated them, captured Sizhai, destroyed the chief rebel Li Wencheng, took Huacheng, seized rebel leaders, and was granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 移剿陝西三才峽匪。

translations.literal: He was transferred to suppress the bandits of Sancaixia in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was then transferred to suppress the bandits of Sancaixia in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 事平，擢黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: When the affair was pacified, he was promoted to general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: After pacification he was promoted to general of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 調烏里雅蘇台將軍、塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣、葉爾羌辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to general at Uliasutai, assistant military governor at Tarbagatai, and resident commissioner at Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: He served as general at Uliasutai, assistant military governor at Tarbagatai, and resident commissioner at Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 召授正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed commandant of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled and appointed commandant of the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 張格爾之亂，命赴阿克蘇。

translations.literal: During the Zhangge'er rebellion he was ordered to proceed to Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jahangir Khoja rebellion he was ordered to Aksu.

sentences.zh: 尋署甘肅提督，兼西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he acted as Gansu provincial military commander and concurrently served as resident commissioner at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as acting Gansu provincial military commander and concurrently as resident commissioner at Xining.

sentences.zh: 歷綏遠城、黑龍江、寧夏、西安將軍。

translations.literal: He successively served as general at Suiyuan, Heilongjiang, Ningxia, and Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as general at Suiyuan, Heilongjiang, Ningxia, and Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 調伊犁，承玉麟之後​​，休息邊氓，撫馭夷部。

translations.literal: Transferred to Ili, succeeding after Yu Lin, he let the frontier populace rest and pacified the foreign tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Ili after Yu Lin, he allowed the frontier populace to recover and pacified the foreign tribes.

sentences.zh: 巴爾楚克諸地屯田漸興，酌撤防兵。

translations.literal: Frontier colonies in Balchuan and other places gradually flourished, and garrison troops were judiciously reduced.
translations.idiomatic: As frontier colonies around Balchuan gradually prospered, garrison troops were judiciously reduced.

sentences.zh: 在任五年，邊疆無事。

translations.literal: During five years in office the borderlands were without incident.
translations.idiomatic: During his five years in office the frontier remained peaceful.

sentences.zh: 道光十八年，入覲，詔嘉其治邊措施悉當，加太子太保，授內大臣，留京供職。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Daoguang he came to audience; an edict praised all his frontier measures as appropriate, advanced him to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, appointed him grand minister, and kept him at the capital on duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Daoguang (1838) he came to audience; the emperor praised his frontier policies as entirely sound, made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and grand minister, and retained him at the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed chief grand minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed chief grand minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 二十年，病，請解職。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he fell ill and requested to resign his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1840) he fell ill and requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，賜卹如例。

translations.literal: Before long he died and was granted condolence payments according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward and received the usual condolence grants.

sentences.zh: 論曰：回疆之役，削平易而善後難。

translations.literal: The commentary says: In the Muslim frontier campaign, conquest was easy but aftermath was hard.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observed: In the Muslim frontier campaigns, conquest was easy but securing the aftermath was hard.

sentences.zh: 長齡持重於始，老成之謀。

translations.literal: Chang Ling was prudent at the outset—a seasoned strategist's counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling was prudent at the outset, offering the counsel of experience.

sentences.zh: 那彥成力袪積弊，善矣，而操切肇釁，未竟厥功。

translations.literal: Na Yancheng strove to remove accumulated abuses—well done—but his harsh precipitancy provoked trouble and he did not complete his achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Na Yancheng worked hard to remove accumulated abuses, which was admirable, but his harsh precipitancy provoked new troubles and he did not finish what he had begun.

sentences.zh: 玉麟以樞臣自請治邊，補救綢繆，西陲乃得乂安無事。

translations.literal: Yu Lin, as a Grand Council minister, volunteered to govern the frontier, repaired oversights, and the western borderlands then attained peace and security.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lin, a Grand Council minister, volunteered to govern the frontier, repaired oversights, and the western borderlands were restored to lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 紫閣銘勳，蓋非幸已。

translations.literal: Portraits inscribed in the Hall of Purple Splendor—their honors were surely not mere fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Their portraits in the Hall of Purple Splendor were honors earned, not mere luck.
